measurement.scope: streaming loop, fused op per iteration (device trace)

mapping: whole GEMM, 512-column strips as DRAM iterations, one <= 512-row tile
window_model: count-based equal-share: offchip_window_count = HLO window count; geometry and partial edge windows not represented

window_switch_cycle.status: empirically fitted effective cost, not a measured hardware constant; mechanism unidentified
window_switch_cycle.source: 2026-11-04 profile run, 4 int8 M = 128 cases (0.393 us), with R 752 GB/s and F 2 us fitted on earlier stream data; fixed before the 2026-11-12 balance run; one value for both dtypes
window_switch_cycle.regime: XLA streaming loop on TPU v5e (JAX 0.11.2); not for staged / isolated one-op programs or shapes without an HLO

assumptions: NOT simulated in either mode: the fused op's input add, output conversion and reduction, and its 4-byte result

fused_output_consumer = 1: input read from DRAM, output matrix not materialized (no whole-tensor capacity); matches the compiler's static accounting of the loop's fused op (weights + M x K x 2 read, 4 B written), which is not measured traffic
